pages: Wilf, sixteen, dark-haired, wearing a navy railway coat with brass buttons and the collar turned up, stands alone in the timber signal box with one palm flat on a small black iron stove. Middle distance: a bare wooden desk, a brass-framed clock. Background: fog pressed grey against every window. Light: one paraffin lamp, low and yellow.

Wilf, sixteen, dark-haired, in the navy railway coat with brass buttons, presses one fingertip to a small card nailed to the window frame, its chalk number rubbed soft. Middle distance: the brass window lever frame, his peaked cap on the desk. Background: the valley road below, lost in fog. Light: grey daylight, flat and shadowless.

Wilf, sixteen, dark-haired, in the navy railway coat with brass buttons, turns one round oak token over in his palm, a brass ring through its centre, the stamped face dark with handling. Middle distance: a canvas token pouch on the desk, the register shut beside it. Background: fog outside the small window. Light: one paraffin lamp, low and yellow.

Wilf, sixteen, dark-haired, in the navy railway coat with brass buttons, lays one round oak token into a canvas pouch on the desk, the brass ring lying flat on the cloth. Middle distance: the register, a blotter, the pen in its stand. Background: the window frame, the fog beyond. Light: one paraffin lamp, low and yellow.

Wilf, sixteen, dark-haired, in the navy railway coat with brass buttons, writes with a steel dip pen down one ruled column of a thick train register. Middle distance: the inkwell, a brass paperweight, stacked loose sheets. Background: the box door, the low window. Light: one paraffin lamp, low and yellow.

Wilf, sixteen, dark-haired, in the navy railway coat with brass buttons, leans forward with one hand closed round the brass window handle, listening into the grey. Middle distance: the bare desk, the stove, his peaked cap. Background: fog along the valley, nothing moving in it. Light: flat grey daylight, no shadow.

Wilf, sixteen, dark-haired, in the navy railway coat with brass buttons, pulls one black painted iron lever down in the frame until it locks. Middle distance: the row of levers with their brass targets, the block shelf. Background: the fogged window, the rails below. Light: one paraffin lamp, low and yellow.

Wilf, sixteen, dark-haired, in the navy railway coat with brass buttons, stands at the window with one hand on the sash rail, lips moving, counting as the wagons go by. Middle distance: one black wagon wheel turning, a buffer beam. Background: fog taking the length of the train away. Light: grey dusk, lamplight inside.

Wilf, sixteen, dark-haired, in the navy railway coat with brass buttons, walks backwards along the loop road holding one brass hand lamp low over the rails. Middle distance: the ballast, one buffer beam at his knee. Background: wagons standing in fog, the night. Light: the lamp throws a small warm circle.

Wilf, sixteen, dark-haired, in the navy railway coat with brass buttons, runs his fingertips along one wagon solebar, a stencilled number there he cannot make out. Middle distance: buffer beams, coupling hooks, wet rails. Background: the train lost in fog, his lamp in the dark. Light: the lamp, low, on the iron.

Wilf, sixteen, dark-haired, in the navy railway coat with brass buttons, writes in the open register on the desk and leaves the rest of the line blank. Middle distance: the pen laid down, the oak token beside his hand. Background: the levers, the fogged window. Light: one paraffin lamp, low and yellow.

Wilf, sixteen, dark-haired, in the navy railway coat with brass buttons, leans half out of the box window, one hand on the ledge, looking at the standing train. Middle distance: one signal post with a red lamp, the wet rails. Background: fog, the tail of the goods out of sight. Light: the signal lamp against grey dusk.

Wilf, sixteen, dark-haired, in the navy railway coat with brass buttons, stands with one hand closed on a black iron point lever, waiting. Middle distance: the token pouch on the desk, a hand lamp on its hook. Background: wagons standing past the window, a red lamp in the murk. Light: paraffin lamp, low and yellow.

Wilf, sixteen, dark-haired, in the navy railway coat with brass buttons, puts his head out of the open window, one hand flat on the sill, peering into the dark. Middle distance: one lantern burning low under the far end of the train. Background: fog, the check rail. Light: the lantern, low and far off.

Wilf, sixteen, dark-haired, in the navy railway coat with brass buttons, holds one black field telephone receiver to his ear, the wire running up the box side. Middle distance: the register open, the pen across it. Background: the fogged window, the standing train. Light: one paraffin lamp, low and yellow.

Wilf, sixteen, dark-haired, in the navy railway coat with brass buttons, stands at the window with one hand on the brass handle, thinking, one red tail lamp on its bracket beside him. Middle distance: the register, the token pouch, the stove. Background: the box wall, the night pressing at the glass. Light: paraffin lamp, low and yellow.

Wilf, sixteen, dark-haired, in the navy railway coat with brass buttons, sets a steel dip pen to the ruled column and writes the time, reading the line back as he goes. Middle distance: the inkwell, the register open on the desk. Background: the levers, the fogged window. Light: one paraffin lamp, low and yellow.

Wilf, sixteen, dark-haired, in the navy railway coat with brass buttons, holds the shutter open with one hand and looks east at the goods going away, one tail lamp in it. Middle distance: the window ledge, the brass-framed clock. Background: the loop road, points, wet steel. Light: the tail lamp, small, in fog.

Wilf, sixteen, dark-haired, in the navy railway coat with brass buttons, holds one round oak token out on his open palm toward the open door. Middle distance: the register, the token pouch on its hook. Background: the train taking the loop road, fog. Light: one paraffin lamp, low and yellow.

Wilf, sixteen, dark-haired, in the navy railway coat with brass buttons, stands with one hand flat on the wooden block shelf beside the levers. Middle distance: the field telephone on its wire, the register. Background: a train standing at the signal with its lamps on. Light: paraffin lamp, low and yellow.

Wilf, sixteen, dark-haired, in the navy railway coat with brass buttons, turns back through one thick register of years, a finger going down the small neat entries. Middle distance: the bare desk, the inkwell, his peaked cap. Background: the box wall, the small window. Light: one paraffin lamp, low and yellow.

Wilf, sixteen, dark-haired, in the navy railway coat with brass buttons, walks beside the standing wagons holding one brass hand lamp, reaching towards a low dark two-wheeled dray standing among them. Middle distance: shafts out to the side, numbered solebars. Background: fog, the night, wet rail. Light: the lamp, low, on the iron.

Wilf, sixteen, dark-haired, in the navy railway coat with brass buttons, writes with a pencil in his own small notebook on the desk, leaving a blank space in the line. Middle distance: the register shut, the token pouch. Background: the levers, the window, first grey light. Light: cold daylight through fog.
